notes.open_interest: Hyperliquid's public info API serves current open interest only (metaAndAssetCtxs.openInterest, and clearinghouseState for a user); it does not serve historical OI. Options for the owner: (a) forward snapshots - poll metaAndAssetCtxs on a schedule into bronze_perp_oi_snapshots (starts when the poller is deployed; no back-history); (b) backfill from Hyperliquid's published node-data archive on S3 if the owner enables requester-pays access (verify licence, retention and egress cost first); (c) use a candle-derived proxy, which is not OI and must be labelled as such. This probe does not attempt an OI history fetch.
